create.name: Sarana Miller
create.bio:
Sarana Miller has taught yoga for more than twenty years. Her approach rests mainly on the Iyengar tradition, with its care for precise alignment and moving with the breath, and she has also studied with Rodney Yee, Ana Forrest, Sarah Powers and Thomas Fortel, as well as with the kirtan singer Jai Uttal, whose influence shows in the chanting that opens many of her sessions. She has presented at Yoga Journal Live events, and her livestream classes were written up in The New York Times in 2020.

She divides her year between Berkeley, California, and Haines, Alaska, where she lives with her husband, the performer and filmmaker Aaron Davidman. Her weekly classes run online with sliding-scale passes, and her retreats follow the seasons: solstice and equinox weekends at Esalen in Big Sur, regular weekends at Wilbur Hot Springs in northern California, summer retreats in a yurt beside the Chilkat Inlet in Haines, and day-long gatherings at Green Gulch Farm. A typical day moves from chanting, breathing practice and meditation into an active asana session, with restorative poses later on. She welcomes all levels and regularly gives classes to raise money for community causes.

courses.title: Aligning with Nature: A Winter Solstice Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur marking the winter solstice with yoga, meditation and chanting. The emphasis is on slowing down, turning inward and practising together before the new year. All levels are welcome.

courses.title: Spring Equinox Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen around the March equinox, with balance as its theme on and off the mat. Sessions combine asana, meditation and bhakti chanting in Big Sur's coastal setting.

courses.title: SaranaYoga Weekends at Wilbur Hot Springs
courses.description: Weekend retreats held several times a year at Wilbur Hot Springs in northern California. Four yoga sessions run from Friday evening to Sunday brunch, mixing chanting, pranayama, active practice and restorative poses, with free time for the mineral baths and trails; meals and two nights' lodging are included.
courses.price: $705–$1,175 USD per person, by room (2026 pricing)

courses.title: Summer Yoga Retreats in Haines, Alaska
courses.description: Extended summer weekends of yoga in a yurt on the Chilkat Inlet near Haines, with morning practice, afternoon restorative sessions, lunches and dinners. Guests arrange their own lodging, with yurts available at the retreat property.

courses.title: Livestream Yoga Classes
courses.description: Weekly online classes, including a Wednesday morning yoga series and Sunday sessions, booked through monthly passes or drop-ins. Recordings stay available for a month, and prices are on a sliding scale.
